title: Cap. IV Arg. 3 Sol: beneplacitum that includes praedestinatio is the arcane will from the mass
pass_a_gloss: That good pleasure therefore in which predestination itself is included is that eternal and secret will of God, by which he established with himself, from the same mass of perdition to lead certain persons infallibly to glory from pure mercy through efficacious grace, others according to justice being left in merited perdition.
pass_b_english: The good pleasure that actually includes predestination is not those declared statutes, but God's eternal secret will: from the same mass of perdition he resolved with himself to lead some persons infallibly to glory by pure mercy through efficacious grace, and according to justice to leave others in the perdition they merit.
source_text: Beneplacitum ergo illud in quo ipsa praedestinatio includitur, est aeterna illa et arcana Dei voluntas, qua statuit apud se, ex eadem perditionis massa quasdam personas ex pura misericordia per gratiam efficacem ad gloriam infallibiliter perducere, aliis secundum justitiam in merita perditione relictis.
